target.title: fix(dashboard): restore Bay review handoff pressure
target.body:
Related: #555, #567, #569, #586

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenClaw Bay operators would lose the review-handoff pressure trend and backlog context after the broad rollback in #586, even though the Bay demo and its underlying exact-review queue remained available.

## Why This Change Was Made

This restores only the bounded, read-only observability introduced by #555 and #569: exact-review pressure telemetry, a three-hour five-minute-bucket history, and the Bay trend panel. It intentionally does not restore the reverted campaign's scheduler, workflow, queue-admission, or mutation behaviour.

The restored metric counts only review-admission work. Artifact-publication rows use a separate publisher slot, so they no longer make a free review slot look saturated. The history key is versioned to start a clean v2 trend rather than mixing the prior aggregation into the new one.

## User Impact

OpenClaw Bay again shows whether review-admission backlog is rising, falling, or steady, together with the current count waiting to admit. Immediately after deploy it shows a collecting state until it has two five-minute observations; it then displays only correctly comparable review-pressure samples.

The dashboard still makes no additional GitHub API scan or mutation for this feature: it reads the existing local durable exact-review queue and bounded history. Browser proof observed zero direct GitHub API requests and zero mutation requests.

## Evidence

Focused validation after the review fixes:

```text
pnpm run build:dashboard
node --test test/dashboard-worker.test.ts test/exact-review-health.test.ts test/dashboard-smoke.test.ts
pnpm run lint:dashboard
pnpm exec oxfmt --check dashboard/bay-page.ts dashboard/exact-review-health.ts dashboard/worker.ts test/dashboard-worker.test.ts test/exact-review-health.test.ts test/dashboard-smoke.test.ts scripts/dashboard-smoke.mjs docs/proof/openclaw-bay/run-proof.mjs
git diff --check
```

Result: dashboard build and lint passed; 124 focused tests passed; all touched dashboard/proof files passed formatting and whitespace checks.

Browser proof ran from commit `51febf97fe7a2598f4ed0418a4c81c9145ec51ef` with Crabbox local-container lease `cbx_6815cc813ae3` (`mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble`): 28 assertions and 18 evidence frames passed, with 0 direct GitHub API requests and 0 mutating requests. Existing deterministic Bay proof artifacts remain in `docs/proof/openclaw-bay/`.

Codex review closeout:

- The first branch review found that publisher rows were counted as review-capacity pressure; this is now covered by a regression test and excluded from both current pressure and history.
- The follow-up review found that v1 history would briefly mix the old semantics after deployment; the v2 history key starts a clean series instead.
- Final `codex review --uncommitted` and `codex review --base origin/main` found no actionable findings.

The repository-wide formatter check still reports pre-existing formatting issues in untouched files; the focused formatter command above is clean for every touched file.

## Risks and Rollout

The pressure value is observational only: no workflow, planner, admission, continuation, dispatch, or queue-capacity decision consumes it. Rollout begins with an intentionally empty v2 history; the first visible trend appears after the second five-minute bucket. No changelog change is included.

## Attribution

This restores the bounded observability from #555 and #569 after #586. #569 carried the Bay pressure work from #567; the original commit provenance is retained through cherry-picks.
